# GenText

> > GenText is an AI-powered academic writing assistant integrated into Microsoft Word, leveraging 200M+ peer-reviewed papers to help students and researchers with writing, citations, and scholarly work.

GenText provides a comprehensive suite of tools for academic writing including AI-assisted composition, citation management across multiple formats (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, Vancouver, IEEE), and Word templates. The platform serves a global audience with support for 8+ languages and offers flexible pricing plans from free to premium tiers.

## Key Topics

- AI writing assistant
- Microsoft Word integration
- Citation management (APA, MLA, Chicago)
- Academic writing
- Paraphrasing tools
- Research paper writing
- Student productivity
- Peer-reviewed articles
- Word templates
- Citation generator
- AI-powered tool
- Microsoft Word add-in
- Thesis writing
- GenText Group products
- Multilingual support

## Core Product

- [GenText Home](https://gentext.ai): GenText homepage: AI-powered Word add-in for academic writing with 200M+ papers.
- [Pricing Plans](https://gentext.ai/pricing): GenText pricing plans: Free, Premium ($19/mo), Business ($29/mo) with feature comparison.
- [GenText Group Products](https://gentext.ai/products): GenText Group product lineup: GenText, LexDraft, MentalNote Word add-ins.

## Citation & Reference Tools

- [Free Citation Generator](https://gentext.ai/tools/citation-generator): Free citation generator supporting APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, Vancouver, IEEE formats.
- [Comprehensive Guides](https://gentext.ai/guides): Comprehensive guides on Word, citation formatting (APA/MLA/Chicago), thesis requirements.
- [Free Word Templates](https://gentext.ai/templates): 100+ free Word templates for papers, theses, essays in APA, MLA, Chicago formats.
